combination.name: The EN 1990 load-combination record itself — the scalar design values (change-permanent-action, change-resistance, change-consequence-class, change-seismic-action, set-snapshot) that this basis-of-design document carries as ONE-per-document fields, never a repeating entry.

variable-actions.name: The `qK` register — the repeating, positionally-addressed collection of variable-action entries (insert-variable-action, remove-variable-action, reorder-variable-actions, change-variable-action-category, change-variable-action-value) that combine into the permanent action to produce a design value. Unlike `combination`'s scalar fields this is a genuine array with insert/remove/reorder semantics, so it is the smallest owner for these five mutations rather than the document as a whole.
